changes: Selected configured provider advertises its supported models in Android and web session/continuation pickers.
Authenticated provider metadata lookup, short cache and single-flight deduplication; no inference for discovery.
Manual model entry remains available if the provider does not expose a compatible catalog; late responses preserve the selected provider and typed value.

verification.push: one announcement; FCM accepted on first attempt

retainedQualificationFailures: Original runner used an incompatible Node version; subsequent runner uses the existing Node22 explicitly.
Unconfined test frame callback failed a layout-thread check; controlled scheduler is scoped to the provider/context test class.
Missing experimental test API opt-in caused one test compile failure.
Original continuation test changed its synthetic receipt before the first read completed; added a read-completion barrier without repeating the operation.
Applying the scheduler change to unrelated reading tests affected native waits/focus; those changes were reverted. Final original reading assertions passed.
limits: Android publication and FCM acceptance do not establish installation or notification display on the handset.
Provider metadata advertises names; no inference was started to certify every model.
Local catalog timings are individual observations, not a handset latency guarantee.
Physical voice and provider audio were not exercised. Separate DeepSeek-only backend does not configure this local provider and was not restarted.
